name: Smart Camera Culling v1.2.0
description: Blender 4.5 add-on Smart Camera Culling v1.2.0, benchmark and analysis scripts, and all measurement data for the article “Optimasi Render Adegan Prosedural Skala Besar pada Blender melalui Frustum Culling Kamera Berbasis Bounding Sphere di Geometry Nodes” (optimizing the rendering of large-scale procedural scenes in Blender through bounding-sphere camera frustum culling in Geometry Nodes). Includes the main factorial benchmark (4 scene families, 3 seeds, 3 camera paths, 342 measured runs), supplementary experiments (high resolution and sample counts, heavy assets, test-retest), GPU rendering on five devices (OptiX and Metal), numerical validation, and functional tests. See README.md.
